name: singlet_demux_donor_deconvolution_reference_free
title: Reference-free donor deconvolution
description: Assigns the droplets of a pooled sample to anonymous donors when no donor genotypes are available, from alt and total counts at informative variants. The default method, vireo, returns donor posteriors and cross-donor doublet probabilities; souporcell and freemuxlet are alternatives. Requires k. Use demux.donor_assignment_reference_genotypes when reference genotypes exist. Writes anonymous labels, not individual identities.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle.

method.description: Donor deconvolution method. vireo is the default; the others are alternatives.

k.description: Number of donors in the pool. Required: all three methods take it as input.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for restarts and initialisations; reproduces labels on one device.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

vireo.description: Options used only when method is vireo.

n_init.description: Random initialisations when learning donor genotype states.

n_extra_donor.description: Extra donors in the initial search; null uses round(sqrt(k)).

check_doublet.description: Score cross-donor doublets with the pair model.

check_ambient.description: Detect ambient RNA per droplet with the ambient-profile EM.

doublet_rate_prior.description: Prior doublet rate; null uses min(0.5, droplets / 100000).

doublet_threshold.description: Posterior at or above which a droplet is called doublet.

unassigned_threshold.description: Droplets whose maximum donor posterior is below this are unassigned.

min_variants.description: Droplets covering fewer informative variants are unassigned.

souporcell.description: Options used only when method is souporcell.

restarts.description: Random restarts of clustering; the repository advises more above 12 clusters.

souporcell3.description: High-donor iterated mode; the repository advises it above 16 donors.

min_alt.description: Minimum alt UMIs at a locus for it to be used.

min_ref.description: Minimum reference UMIs at a locus for it to be used.

max_loci.description: Maximum informative loci per droplet; larger values cost more time.

doublet_threshold.description: Troublet posterior at or above which a cross-cluster doublet is called.

freemuxlet.description: Options used only when method is freemuxlet.

doublet_prior.description: Prior doublet fraction in the singlet and doublet hypotheses.

min_base_quality.description: Minimum base quality in the pileup step (dsc-pileup).

min_mapping_quality.description: Minimum mapping quality in the pileup step (dsc-pileup).

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/donor_cluster. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Method, k, singlet, unassigned and doublet fractions; elbo for vireo. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
